text:
The two of them went dressed with defiance
(miniskirt, long hair),
hand in hand,
so young they almost frightened you,
so absorbed in a zero
that, though unseen, joined them as absolutes,
something fiercely pure.
They went anywhere, hand in hand.
They loved without sadness,
or joy, or anything.
Sometimes they looked at each other, but did not see.
Then they sat on some bench.
But they did not see.
She was very pretty; she seemed dazed;
he was fierce and scrawny.
They did not speak. They had nothing more to say.
They no longer desired each other.
But they stayed together, hand in hand,
facing something terrifying.

While the transistor radio kept playing.

translation.title: The Two of Them Went Dressed with Defiance...
